# vendor

Third-party libraries served locally instead of via CDN so the PWA
works fully offline.

| file              | source                                                      | license     |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| `jszip.min.js`    | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jszip@3.10.1/dist/jszip.min.js | MIT / GPLv3 |

Refresh with:

```
curl -fsSL -o site/vendor/jszip.min.js https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jszip@3.10.1/dist/jszip.min.js
```
